purpose: Teach: 甚だ/へた/恐る恐る/とてつもない/なにかと/めずらしく/ほんのり/つき合い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、甚だ嬉しい気持ちよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm really happy you're here with me.
lines.style: Warm opening, genuine smile in the voice. Soft and unhurried. The kind of gladness that doesn't need to be performed, just offered quietly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きまだへたなんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm still not very good at drawing.
lines.style: Small, self-aware voice. Not fishing for reassurance. Matter-of-fact about his own limitation, the way observant kids are. Slight downward pitch at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが、恐る恐る新しい技法を試したのよ
lines.en: Sho, I tried something new with my art today. Was a little nervous about it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. She's letting him in on something small but real. Careful with the words, like she's choosing them for him to understand, not for performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、とてつもない長い絵を描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew a really long picture this morning.
lines.style: Bright lift on the opening. Genuine pride without boasting. Small voice, but steady. The kind of thing a six-year-old says when he's done something that felt big to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは、なにかと翔くんを応援してるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know I'm always cheering you on, in my own way.
lines.style: Tender but solid. Not gushing. The reassurance of someone who means it and has already shown it. A gentle promise underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、今朝、めずらしく早起きしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I woke up really early this morning. That's unusual for me.
lines.style: Quiet excitement underneath. He's reporting something that mattered enough to wake for. Simple words, genuine announcement. A small brightness in his usual observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ほんのり甘いお菓子作りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's make something sweet together today.
lines.style: Inviting, warm. Opening soft and simple. The idea itself carries the affection. Not insistent, but gently including him in something she wants to share.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんとのつき合い、ずっと続けたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to keep spending time with you like this. Forever.
lines.style: Quiet, serious at the centre. A child's way of saying something that matters. Not shy, but sincere. Steady eye contact in the voice. No trailing off—he means it completely.
